description: Regression cases for the documented agent workflow contract; these fixtures do not claim to execute or prove a live model.

cases.situation: A tracked task is active, a substep has completed, and another concrete agent-owned repository action is executable now.
Hosted CI is unavailable or did not start, but implementation, investigation, deterministic tests, Git, or GitHub work remains agent-owned and executable.
A relevant authorized CI/build/check has started and is still pending. A bounded wait followed by another status poll is available.
An agent resumes a tracked PR and relevant queued/running checks already exist for its current candidate.
A relevant CI run for the current candidate and validation purpose is still queued or running.
A GeoDot/world-renderer-only implementation iteration has no changed dependency or required final gate involving police/dispatch.
Implementation/debugging is still active and targeted or relevant integration validation can answer the current question.
The project leader explicitly said to stop full CI/full tests for the active task while other targeted implementation and validation work remains.
Implementation is complete, targeted and relevant integration validation are green, candidate is frozen, no validation-scope restriction is active, and a final broad gate is actually required.
An objective test is red and the failure can be diagnosed or repaired with available tools.
A human-executed Safe Check reports an objective failure and agent-owned diagnosis or repair remains.

An agent is about to present a Safe Check link, but merge-decision syntax, exact PR head, handoff contract, or an agent-executable objective prerequisite has not yet been verified green for the handoff candidate.
Safe Check failed on merge-decision parsing. The agent repaired the marker but has not exhausted the objective/downstream path.
Safe Check failed because an irrelevant legacy PBF stage ran. The agent repaired scope but has not exhausted remaining objective/downstream validation.
All relevant agent-owned objective/downstream validation is green for exact head and only the concrete perceptual check remains.
A small implementation edit is still in the debugging loop and a smaller deterministic validation can answer the current question.
All relevant available objective validation is complete and the only remaining requirement is a genuinely perceptual, interactive, hardware-specific, or otherwise non-automatable human check.
Requested scope, required objective validation, delivery metadata, and agent-owned cleanup are complete and no human-only check remains.
